# AccuVideo

AccuVideo is a local-first video intelligence application that helps users search large video libraries by meaning rather than by scrubbing through timelines. It analyzes spoken words, on-screen text, and visual content to answer natural-language questions and jump to the exact moment in a video.

## Product overview
- [Short demo in English] (https://accuvideo.acornjuice.com/assets/videos/demo-en.mp4): Short Engish demo.
- [Short demo in Spanish] (https://accuvideo.acornjuice.com/assets/videos/demo-es.mp4): Short Spanish demo.
- [Walkthrough video] (https://accuvideo.acornjuice.com/assets/videos/AccuVideo_Horizontal.mp4): 3 minutes Walkthrough video.


## Editions
- **Basic**: Basic is ideal for individuals, students, and smaller collections.
- **Pro**: Adds visual understanding, batch ingestion, scheduled processing, and multi-client LAN streaming for larger organizations and archives.
- [Basic] ([Pricing]https://accuvideo.acornjuice.com/#editions): See editions section on the main website.

## Pricing
- [Pricing](https://accuvideo.acornjuice.com/#pricing): See the pricing section on the main site.

## Key features
- Semantic search over spoken words, on-screen text, and visual content.
- Exact-second navigation to the relevant moment in a video.
- Local transcription and indexing with optional GPU acceleration on compatible NVIDIA hardware.
- In-app ingestion for folders and files, plus a command-line tool for large-scale batch processing.
- Multilingual transcription and optional translation-based search.
- Support for large archives, scheduled overnight processing, and multi-client LAN streaming in Pro.
- [Features](https://accuvideo.acornjuice.com/#features): See more on the website.
